SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Good Grooming practices • Dressing • Etiquette, part of HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learnin in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How does good grooming promote personal hygiene?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Good Grooming practices • Dressing • Etiquette together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Respect: The learner exhibits open mindedness in appreciating peers’ personal hygiene practices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Preventive health: The learners practise good grooming and cleanliness which helps with prevention of illnesses related to poor hygiene.

Link to other subjects:

Creative arts: The learner comes up with different designs of dressing while practising daily grooming.

Suggested learning resources:

• Print and non-print media.

• Digital devices.

• Resource persons.

• Different types of clothes

• Grooming kit with items like toothbrushes, combs, nail clippers,

• Dining setting- to role play dining etiquette
